enriched.title: Past Continuous e Vocabulário Diversificado
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do Past Continuous e sua aplicação em diversos contextos, além de apresentar vocabulário relacionado a situações cotidianas e eventos globais, com exemplos práticos e traduções.
mainTopics: Vocabulário sobre eventos globais e ações cotidianas
Expressões idiomáticas e situações do dia a dia

vocabulary.definition: To say no to something that is offered.
examples: The stand-up comedian refused the one-million-dollar offer.

vocabulary.definition: To commit to doing something or assure someone that something will happen.
examples: Trump promised that he will end the war in Ukraine.
I promise to call you tomorrow.

vocabulary.definition: To develop or improve over time.
examples: Medicine will progress much faster with the help of AI.
Technology has progressed significantly in recent years.

vocabulary.definition: The process of planning income and expenses for a specific period.
examples: Was your department doing the budgeting for next year?
Budgeting is essential for saving money.

vocabulary.definition: Medical care given to a patient for an illness or injury.
examples: AI is helping in the treatment of cancer.
She is receiving treatment for her condition.

vocabulary.definition: To stop working permanently, usually due to age.
examples: What are you going to do when you retire?
He retired at the age of 65.

grammar.explanation: The Past Continuous describes actions that were ongoing in the past, often interrupted by another action.
rules: Often accompanied by specific time markers like 'while' or 'when.'
examples: While I was doing shopping for Christmas, I also bought some things for me.
Was your department doing the budgeting for next year when the Director left the company?
commonMistakes: Using 'was' with plural subjects (e.g., 'They was working').
Forgetting to add '-ing' to the verb (e.g., 'He was work').

expressions.usage: Usado para perguntar ou afirmar sobre diversão em uma situação.
examples: Did you have a good time in Vancouver?
I also bought some things for me.

practiceQuestions.question: Form a sentence using Past Continuous: 'She / wear / coat / leave'.
practiceQuestions.answer: She was wearing a coat when she left.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Past Continuous is formed using 'was/were' + verb(-ing).

practiceQuestions.question: Translate: 'Eles estavam indo para Paris.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: The verb 'were going' indicates the Past Continuous tense.

culturalNotes: O uso de 'AI' na medicina é um tema global em debates sobre tecnologia e saúde.
A colonização de Marte representa um avanço científico frequentemente discutido na mídia.
studyTips: Pratique a conjugação do Past Continuous com diferentes sujeitos e verbos.
Use as frases de exemplo da aula para criar novas sentenças similares.
originalExamples: The stand-up comedian refused the one-million-dollar offer to participate in a festival in the Middle East. (O comediante de stand-up recusou a oferta de um milhão de dólares para participar de um festival no Oriente Médio.)
Trump promised that he will end the war in Ukraine. (Trump prometeu que ele acabará com a guerra na Ucrânia.)
Medicine will progress much faster with the help of AI especially in the treatment of cancer. (A medicina progredirá mais rapidamente com a ajuda da IA, especialmente no tratamento do câncer.)
While I was doing shopping for Christmas, I also bought some things for me. (Enquanto eu estava fazendo compras para o Natal, eu também comprei algumas coisas para mim.)
Was your department doing the budgeting for next year when the Director left the company? (Seu departamento estava fazendo o orçamento do próximo ano quando o Diretor deixou a empresa?)
He met his wife when he was working in Japan. (Ele conheceu sua esposa quando ele estava trabalhando no Japão.)
Did you have fun / have a good time in Vancouver? (Vocês se divertiram em Vancouver?)
Was she wearing a coat when she left? (Ela estava usando um casaco quando ela saiu?)
When will we colonize Mars? (Quando colonizaremos Marte?)
What are you going to do when you retire? (O que você vai fazer quando aposentar-se?)
Were you driving at high speed when the police stopped you? (Você estava dirigindo a alta velocidade quando a polícia o parou?)
I met Tom and Jane at the airport some weeks ago. (Encontrei Tom e Jane no aeroporto algumas semanas atrás.)
They were going to Paris. (Eles estavam indo para Paris.)
We talked while we were waiting for our flights. (Nós conversamos enquanto esperávamos por nossos vôos.)
